chunks: And in the narration of Jamil, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, he said:
"His neck is to be struck," or he said, "his neck."

key_terms.رَقَبَتُهُ: His neck; a variant wording for the same penal expression
key_terms.يُضْرَبُ عُنُقُهُ: His neck is to be struck; an expression indicating execution

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the punishment expressed by the phrase "his neck is to be struck"?
ai.summary: This report conveys a brief legal ruling indicating execution by striking the neck. It appears in a juridical context dealing with penal rulings related to adultery and reflects concise hadith wording used in fiqh transmission.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5044 - In the narration of Jamil from Abu Abdullah (as), he said: "His neck is to be struck,"
